september_30.note: Notes 1, 4 and 10. Current debt and long-term debt include finance leases. Tariff obligations are approximate. Treat the cash and offsetting refund liability consistently when normalizing cash flow and working capital.

supply_chain_sale.note: Note 14. Approximate net proceeds. Recognize once as subsequent investing cash flow. The filing did not provide a final disposal gain, sale tax or standalone operating results.

quotes.note: Latest common dated closes confirmed by the listed providers for this snapshot. November 12 FDX close differed across the observed data providers.

limitations: Reported September cash adjusted for the disclosed customer obligation is a measure before any operating cash reserve. It is not excess cash or a November cash balance.
The FDXF mark uses the previously disclosed share count and the dated close. It is an indicative gross mark without a sale or tax assumption.

FedEx paid $2,501 million for the InPost investment in September. September cash already reflects it. Use the separate equity-method asset only if its earnings and cash flows stay out of the core forecast.
The Freight dividend and related tender predate the September balance sheet. Use the reported debt and cash starting balances without repeating those transactions.
